events.title: Prysmian SpA (PRYMF) Q4 2025 Earnings Call Highlights: Record EBITDA and Strategic Growth ...
events.body: Prysmian SpA (PRYMF) reports robust financial performance with significant EBITDA growth and strategic acquisitions, despite facing market challenges.

events.title: Prysmian secures $2.7bn contract for Eastern Green Link 4 project
events.body: The company will deliver more than 640km of HVDC cable for the subsea project, which aims to connect Scotland and England by 2033.
